Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes Adds compact mobile composer presentation, retained editing across controls and menus, and access to the existing mention operation. **Example:** At a 430px viewport, select characters 2–8 in a draft and open the Plus menu. - **Before:** The composer has no dedicated mobile editing state that follows its controls and overlays. - **After:** The proposed mobile presentation retains the textarea, draft, and selection through menu focus and Escape without sending. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | The inspected implementation is coherent and has focused supporting tests, but required visual and integrated mobile behavior evidence is absent. | | **Proof confidence** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | Real behavior proof is not required for maintainer- or bot-authored pull requests. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Feature · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Partial **User problem:** Mobile users need a compact composer that preserves their editing position while they use its controls. **Reason:** Maintainer authorship establishes direction; the component work has clear value, while the explicitly pending pane integration prevents this head from delivering the full app experience. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep this maintainer-authored draft open: it contains coherent mobile-composer work that current main does not provide, with no definite introduced regression found. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `798355a2185f934656070c3957636f2c768367cb` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None. ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: Missing the integrated mobile pane flow on WebKit with actual keyboard dismissal, retained menu focus and selection, and no unintended send.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The Control UI pane supplies session facts and actions to ChatView and the shared Solid composer; local interaction state controls presentation while existing owners retain drafts, mention lookup, and mutations. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Pane session owner] --> B[ChatView] B --> C[Native or delegated surface] C --> D[Shared composer] D --> E[Mobile interaction state] D --> F[Existing draft and mention owners] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Complete the mobile pane bindings while retaining the existing draft, overlay, mention, and mutation owners. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? This proposes a new capability; inspected tests exercise retained draft and caret state, menu focus, keyboard dismissal, and send suppression. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The implementation reuses the appropriate existing owners, but represents a staged component change rather than a complete application flow. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [b518289d703d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b518289d703d9988025471df97b0f37d8178589c). ### Provenance checked - `Stable textarea and draft ownership` keeps the original intent (4ad6f7aee2402b8d53f3d28db365ae70d8937cb6: The draft-owner cutover preserved native input, IME, focus, and disclosure identity across unrelated updates.) - `Mention lookup, caching, and insertion` keeps the original intent (3ca8c08ef47ca567bd844f969f6b6b24611ce5d1: Suggestion state moved to Solid while retaining query caching, same-turn selection, and stale-owner rejection.) - `Goal actions and recovery` keeps the original intent (7ff232960ab65ed8d9498e42362342dbf245dca9: Resume progress and uncertain-outcome recovery remain visible inline without duplicating continuation requests.) - `Compact mobile control presentation` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/130308: Earlier mobile design kept compact controls and primary actions directly accessible; this maintainer-authored proposal deliberately introduces separate compact and editing presentations.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Pinned change and current draft:** Reviewed the introduced merge-base-to-head diff; live GitHub confirms the same head, MEMBER authorship, draft status, and clean mergeability against its stacked base branch. ([798355a2185f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/798355a2185f934656070c3957636f2c768367cb)) - **Interaction owner:** One component-owned interaction factory handles editing, composer-owned overlays, keyboard disappearance, accidental action suppression, and listener cleanup. ([`ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer-mobile-interaction.ts:8`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/798355a2185f934656070c3957636f2c768367cb/ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer-mobile-interaction.ts#L8), [798355a2185f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/798355a2185f934656070c3957636f2c768367cb)) - **Staged integration boundary:** Production callers do not yet supply mobileComposer, mobileKeyboardVisible, or mobileActivities; the body explicitly records complete host integration as pending. ([`ui/src/pages/chat/chat-view.tsx:178`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/798355a2185f934656070c3957636f2c768367cb/ui/src/pages/chat/chat-view.tsx#L178), [798355a2185f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/798355a2185f934656070c3957636f2c768367cb)) - **Shared mention operation:** External lookup shares the existing bounded cache and request owner; insertion rechecks the current directory, recipient, and editable textarea before committing through the existing draft callback. ([`ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer-mention-menu.tsx:417`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/798355a2185f934656070c3957636f2c768367cb/ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer-mention-menu.tsx#L417), [798355a2185f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/798355a2185f934656070c3957636f2c768367cb)) - **Related staged work:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176378 supplies the activity presenter, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176367 supplies mobile approvals, and the downstream https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176505 explicitly consumes this PR's mention operation. - **Existing main behavior and feature history:** Current-main composer code retains the existing desktop/shared presentation; history identifies the Solid composer migration, draft-owner cutover, suggestion-owner migration, and earlier mention-picker contributions.
